## Step 4: Process Standing Orders & Direct Debits  
### Standing Order Cancellation  
**Actions:**
- Cancel all future standing orders (effective immediately)
- Last standing order executes if scheduled before closure date
- Customer notified of cancellation
- Beneficiary(ies) may receive cancellation notice (optional)  
**Timeline:** Same day as closure request

raw_entities.description: End-to-end procedure for cancelling all future standing orders on a customer account during account closure. Includes execution of final scheduled orders, customer notification, and optional beneficiary notification. Executed on the same day as the closure request.
context: Cancel all future standing orders (effective immediately)
Last standing order executes if scheduled before closure date

Timeline: Same day as closure request

raw_entities.name: Cancel Future Standing Orders
raw_entities.description: Immediate cancellation of all future standing orders on the account, with the exception that any standing order already scheduled for execution before the account closure date will be allowed to execute.
context: Cancel all future standing orders (effective immediately)
Last standing order executes if scheduled before closure date

raw_entities.description: Optional notification to standing order beneficiary(ies) informing them of the cancellation of future payments due to account closure.
